correctness.rationale: For an incidence R_i the two consecutive increasing vertex inequalities are necessary and sufficient; L_i forces the opposite two inequalities. Mixed contradictions occur exactly when j-i is 0, 1 or 2 modulo n. Three faces cannot force an oriented directed cycle at n>=7; at n=6 only the four alternating monochromatic triangles do. Both monochromatic full two-skeleta are simply connected, including n=6 where each excluded triangle admits a cone using another same-color vertex. The allowed cross-edge bipartite graph is connected via common neighbors of consecutive R vertices. Each pair of adjacent cross edges lies in a mixed triangle, so van Kampen identifies every cross-edge generator and pi-one is trivial. n=5 sharpness is a cited prior sphere equivalence. Standalone code independently enumerates all vertex orders n=4..8 and checks mod-two H1, yielding 5,1,0,0,0; computations are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
